title: First floor rear room, the 9:30 Club's original home, Atlantic Building
subject: clubs-and-venues
verified: Commons action=raw wikitext quoted: title '...FIRST FLOOR REAR ROOM, SAFE DEPOSIT ROOM (Note- This was the 9-30 Club during the early 1980s) - Atlantic Building, 930 F Street...', permission={{PD-USGov-NPS}}, source=https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/dc0636.photos.030314p. The LOC item record itself carries no capture year (checked via ?fo=json: created_published/date/sort_date all empty). The HABS survey's own written data page (raw PDF, https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/master/pnp/habshaer/dc/dc0600/dc0636/data/dc0636data.pdf, pdftotext extract) is captioned 'PHOTOGRAPHS / REDUCED COPIES OF MEASURED DRAWINGS / WRITTEN HISTORICAL AND DESCRIPTIVE DATA' as one submitted HABS DC-569-A package, and its Historian line reads 'Laura Harris/Elizabeth Jiranek, Traceries, 702 H Street, NW Washington, DC, January 1990', dating that package to January 1990. A second Commons file of the same LOC item (File:9-30Club_WashingtonDC_interior_1990.jpeg, action=raw quoted) independently corroborates: |Date = {{otherdate|summer|1990}}, |Author = John McWilliams, |Source = {{LOC-image|hhh.dc0636/photos.030314p}} -- the same LOC item id as this file, naming the photographer and giving a season-precision 1990 date. Year set to 1990/circa on the convergence of the HABS package date and the corroborating record's summer 1990 date; recovered this round after round one dropped it (research-b/drops.json) for lacking a capture year (verified 2026-09-25/26).
